name: farmledger-erp
description: FarmLedger ERP — farm business management: sales, purchases, cash, inventory, production and double-entry accounting.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
